evidence.quote: Patients must have an intact prostate.

Histologically or cytologically confirmed unresectable advanced/metastatic solid tumor that has relapsed or progressed on or after standard systemic treatments
PSA greater than or equal to (≥) 2 nanogram per milliliter (ng/mL) at screening

evidence.quote: Be starting ADT or have received their first ADT treatment in the past 6 months, with a total of at least 6 planned months of treatment
Be diagnosed with Stage I-IV prostate cancer without metastases to bone

labels.note: Completed 6 months of ADT in March; not currently on ADT.

evidence.quote: PRE-REGISTRATION: Measurable disease and/or non-measurable metastatic disease per RECIST version 1.1.
No prior radiotherapy to the region of the study cancer
Have unresectable and/or metastatic solid tumors (with or without MSI-H/dMMR) refractory to or intolerant to previous SoC therapy
Must have had evidence of metastatic disease (American Joint Committee on Cancer [AJCC] metastasis [M]1 disease) based on conventional CT/MRI and/or bone scan.
